verdicts.why: Wikipedia's episode 6 ('Enter the Hunter!') summary: Sir Ram convinces the High Evolutionary that Spider-Man must be dealt with and hires the Hunter to kill him, so the record's hirer and aim are wrong.
The Moscow informant raid by Silver Sable and the Wild Pack and the countdown bomb end episode 54 (Chapter I); episode 55 opens with Spider-Man escaping the blast.

Episode 57 summary: both sides are trapped by the Red Skull as Silver Sable shows up to help Spider-Man; the fandom page confirms she and the Wild Pack come to help and free the captives. Her change of side has no record, and Allied fits.

Fandom: in episode 38 Eddie breaks the container to rebond, fights beside Spider-Man and Iron Man against Dormammu, then throws Carnage into the portal and sacrifices himself to save Dr. Kafka. Missing fits and matches k4.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
value.text: In episode 33, Corsair leads the Starjammers in seizing the M'Kraan Crystal to trade to D'Ken, then fights D'Ken inside the crystal beside the X-Men and the Imperial Guard.
cases: FX-002 The M'Kraan Crystal Crisis (X-Men: The Animated Series)

verdicts.why: The record is missing (episodes 32-33), but the Starjammers do not just flee: Wikipedia says they turn and run, are then drawn into the crystal, and the three factions unite against D'Ken (Marvel Database trivia agrees). The text is changed to end on that.
Episode 44 ('Orphan's End') is about Corsair being framed and hunted by the Shi'ar and revealed as Cyclops's father. The M'Kraan Crystal is not in it, so FX-002 moves to the new episode 33 record.
Gambit is imprisoned and tortured by Cortez on Asteroid M in 'Sanctuary' (episodes 48-49). The Germany ski trip with Nightcrawler is episode 53, so the record has to end on the episode 53 event.

Only the stub Tinkerer page says he is 'caught'. The same wiki's Electro page describes Spider-Man overturning the getaway van, with Electro escaping and no arrest of the Tinkerer, and he is free again in episode 22. In custody is not clearly supported.
This depends on item 107, which is rejected. The current k1 already ends on its episode 22 event (the Enforcers' suits), so it is valid as it stands.

The New Enforcers are beaten and sent to the Vault in episode 22 ('Probable Cause'). In episode 25 ('Opening Night') Montana joins the Goblin-triggered inmate escape, which is foiled. The record tagged 25 must end on that.
The symbiote is tricked off Eddie in 'Nature vs. Nurture' (13). Eddie packs his things and goes AWOL in 'Blueprints' (14), so the record's last event and its Missing status belong to episode 14.
The episode 8 summary says a horrified Cooper releases Magneto, who then causes the worldwide blackout. The record ends with him free, so Imprisoned is wrong and Active is right.
Nathan's birth, the record's last event, is in episode 2 ('Mutant Liberation Begins'). The clone reveal is episode 3, which k1 already covers.

Episode 64 (Beyond Good and Evil Part 2): despite Shard and Wolverine, Magneto takes Psylocke to Apocalypse at the axis of time, where he is gathering psychics. Bishop frees her in episode 66. Her capture has no record.
Episode 19 ('Survival of the Fittest', season 2 episode 9): X-Force and X-Factor attack X-Corp, Apocalypse brainwashes everyone, and Rogue frees them. Marvel Database lists Havok in that episode.
Logan plot: X-24 impales Logan on a tree branch, and Laura kills X-24 with the adamantium bullet. Logan does not kill X-24.
Storm fires lightning at Jean at the Red Hook house. In New York she fights Selene and Ariki of Magneto's group, not Jean. 'Jean's childhood home (Earth-TRN414)' is already a place in the app.
Fandom: Logan drives the shot-up limo to a hotel in Oklahoma City, abandons it by handing the keys to strangers, and buys a used Ram truck. No source mentions a junkyard.
Episode 1 summary: Jean locates Trask at a junkyard in the Sahara, and the X-Men destroy the Sentinels and a Master Mold there and apprehend him. The file has no record of this capture.

Shaw dies in episode 5, but the record's last event, Emma surviving in diamond form, is only revealed in episode 7: Marvel Database says Cyclops and Jean rescue her from the rubble in Season 1 7 ('Revealed Alive'). The episode 7 tag is correct.
